paite: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
heading: Adam A Kipan Noah Suante / (Gen 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

paite: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

paite: Enok, Methuselah, Lamekh;
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

paite: Noah, Shem, Ham leh Japheth.
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

paite: Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
heading: Japheth Suante
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

paite: Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath, leh Togarmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

paite: Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Rodanim ahi uh.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

paite: Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, leh Put, Kanaan ahi uh.
heading: Ham Suante
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

paite: Kus tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Seba, leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Kush in Nimrod asuang a; amah lei ah mihat ahong hi pan hi.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

paite: Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lahabte, Naphtuhte,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

paite: Pathruste, Kasluhte, Philistiate hong kipatna leh Kaphtorte asuang hi.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

paite: Kanaan in Zidon ata masapen leh Heth asuang a;
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

paite: Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgas mi;
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

paite: Hiv mi, Arki mi, Sin mi.
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

paite: Arvad mi, Zemar mi leh Hamath mi leng asuang hi.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

paite: Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, leh Meshek.
heading: Shem Suante
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

paite: Arpakshad in Shelah asuang a, huan Shelah in Eber asuang hi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

paite: Eber lak ah tapa nih apiang ua: khat pen min Peleg ahi (adam lai in lah lei akikhen ngal a), a-unaupa min Joktan ahi.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

paite: Joktan in Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

paite: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

paite: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba;
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

paite: Ophir, Havilah, leh Jobab asuang hi. Hiaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

paite: Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

paite: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

paite: Serug, Nahor, Terah;
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

paite: Abram, huai mah Abraham ahi.
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

paite: Abraham tapate: Isak leh Ishmael ahi.
heading: Abraham Suante / (Gen 25.12-16)
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

paite: Hiaite akhang kizopdan uh ahi: Ishmael ta masapen Nebajoth ahi. Huan Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

paite: Mishma, Dumah, Massa; Hadad, Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

paite: Jetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah. Hiaite Ishmael tapate ahi uh.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

paite: Keturah, Abraham mei tapate: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah ahi. Jokshan tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Midian tapate: Ephah, Epher, Honok, Abida, leh Eldaah ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Keturah suante ahi uh.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

paite: Abraham in Isak asuang hi. Isak tapate: Esau leh Israel ahi uh.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

paite: Esau tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, leh Korah ahi uh.
heading: Esau Suante / (Gen 36.1-19)
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

paite: Eliphaz tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, leh Amalek ahi uh.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

paite: Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, leh Mizzah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

paite: Seir tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar leh Dishan ahi uh.
heading: Edom Gam Mi Masate / (Gen 36.20-30)
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

paite: Lotan tapate: Hori leh Homam; leh Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi uh.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

paite: Shobal tapate: Alian, Manahath leh Ebal, Shephi leh Onam ahi uh. Huan Zibeon tapate: Aiah leh Anah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

paite: Anah tapa Dishon ahi. Dishon tapate: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Keran ahi uh.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

paite: Ezer tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Jaakan ahi uh. Dishan tapate: Uz leh Aran ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

paite: Huchi in hiaite Israel suante tung a vaihawm kumpipate himhim a-om ma ua, Edom gam a vaihawm kumpipate ahi uhi. Beor tapa Bela, akhopi min Dinhabah ahi.
heading: Edom Kumpipate / (Gen 36.31-43)
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

paite: Bela asi a, huchi in Bozrah a Zerah tapa Jobab in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

paite: Jobab asi a, Teman mite gam a Husham in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

paite: Husham asi a, Bedad, Moab gam a Midian mi thattu, Bedad tapa Hadad in asik in vai ahawm a; akhopi min Avith ahi.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

paite: Hadad asi a, huchi in Masrekah mi Samlah in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

paite: Samlah asi a, huchi in lui kiang a Rehoboth a Shaul in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

paite: Shaul asi a, huchi in Akbor tapa Baal-hanan in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

paite: Baal-hanan asi a, asik in Hadad in vai ahawm a, akhopi min Pai ahi; huan azi min Mehetabel, Matred tanu, Mezahab tanu ahi.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

paite: Hadad leng asi hi. Edom hausa makaite: hausa makai Timnah, hausa makai Aliah, hausa makai Jetheth,
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

paite: hausa makai Aholibamah, hausa makai Elah, hausa makai Pinon,
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

paite: hausa makai Kenaz, hausa makai Teman, hausa makai Mibzar,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

paite: hausa makai Magdiel, leh hausa makai Iram; hiaite Edom hausa makaite ahi uhi.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
